sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior repairs: applicability is now gated by exact-one iceClass and bulbousBowPresent, and non-applicable branches may avoid formula obligations. However, the applicable IA Super/no-bulb branch still uses presence-only sh:node constraints for every operand and C1/C2, so missing values can pass. Add sh:minCount 1 (and retain maxCount 1 where required) for all declared operands and both results in that branch; retain positive B, L, and T checks.
